## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Add the required `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` default so CI can exclude matching files through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters archive entries by filename and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It documents the flag and adds tests for parsing, file collection, and archive contents.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, `skip.log` is archived because the parser always defaults to `[]`. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5` requires each new flag to “take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions through the environment will include files they intended to omit.

## Suggestions

- tests/test_main.py:24 — tests — Test the default through archive contents — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` unset and no `--exclude` argument, using `None` as the parser default and normalizing it before collection would preserve archive contents but fail the test’s exact `[]` assertion. — The test can reject an internal parser change even when the command still archives every source file by default.
